name: hearthvale
description: Walk around your Discord server as a cosy voxel world.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @hearthvale/server" "npm run dev -w @hearthvale/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hearthvale/client && npm run build -w @hearthvale/server
scripts.start:prod: npm run build -w @hearthvale/server && npm run start:prod -w @hearthvale/server
